scope: Screen-based visual inspection of contact sheet for all 10 items; 128px white/navy/checkerboard proofs; enlarged ghost, bat, sunflower and outline WebPs; rendered original US Letter PDFs.
corrections: Moved ghost steam away from smile.
Changed outline pumpkin contour from navy to neutral black; original PDF preserves neutral colors in pure K.

duplicateReview.agentFinding: Similar expected pumpkin silhouette, but separately drawn source paths, different leaves/tendrils, rib arrangement and coloring-page treatment. Retain owner concept review before counting as production-approved originals.

items.note: Clear plump silhouette, contained stroke and warm highlights. Vine extends behind leaf and pumpkin; no clipped canvas edge.
Inspected enlarged WebP and revised steam so it no longer crosses the smile. Cup, folds and cheeks remain legible at 128px.
Inspected enlarged WebP: distinct wing membranes, two ears, small teeth, continuous contour and clean separation from moon.
Eight legs visually counted, symmetric friendly face, fine thread intact. Dark legs have lower contrast on navy; light backgrounds give best legibility.
Apple and foreground slice read separately; seeds and edge band stay legible. Stylized food illustration, no scientific anatomy claim.
Inspected enlarged WebP: petal overlaps render correctly, seeds are clear, leaves connect to stem and no clipping is visible.
Cap pattern and nut silhouette are distinct; stylized oak leaf is legible. Not a botanical species identification diagram.
Bow, lid, ribbon and hanging tag separate cleanly. No text or branded mark is present.
Hat and scarf separate from body, twig arms extend without clipping; face remains clear on white and dark backgrounds.
Inspected enlarged WebP and changed navy contour to neutral black. Source has distinct leaf geometry, vine paths and rib drawing from color pumpkin; meaningful coloring regions.
